title: Homelab
about: For machines and services you run yourself: services, health, backups and logs.

sections.title: Services
sections.text: A link to each service's dashboard (http or https).

sections.title: Health
sections.text: Data tiles for disk free, uptime and failed services. Each one runs a registry script after you answer Allow.

sections.title: Backups
sections.text: A button to start each backup, and a log view of the last run.

sections.title: Logs
sections.text: Log views of the files you read first when something breaks.
